# Copilot instructions

- This is a static, dependency-free GitHub Pages portfolio website.
- Preserve semantic HTML, keyboard accessibility, visible focus states, and responsive behavior.
- Keep the site usable at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.
- Do not invent personal information, employment history, certifications, projects, metrics, or contact details.
- Do not add secrets, API keys, passwords, or private credentials.
- Prefer small, maintainable vanilla JavaScript changes over introducing a framework or build system.
- Validate links, HTML structure, contrast, reduced-motion behavior, and console errors before committing.
